ROOT=Path('/tmp/voice-reply-audio-capture')
def read(p):

  assert f.getframerate()==16000 and f.getnchannels()==1
  return np.frombuffer(f.readframes(f.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').astype(float)
def match(x,y):

 scores=np.divide(dot,den,out=np.zeros_like(dot),where=den>1)
 i=int(np.argmax(scores));return {'offset':i,'correlation':float(scores[i])}

    import json,time,uuid
    from pathlib import Path
    from benchmark.audio_assets import write_wav
    import eidolon.livekit.agent.full_duplex.pipeline as pipeline_module
    original_build=pipeline_module.build_full_duplex_agent
    def observed_build(pipeline):
        agent=original_build(pipeline)
        original_tts=agent.tts_node
        async def observed_tts(text, model_settings):
            timeline=pipeline._timeline
            room=getattr(pipeline._room,'name','')
            turn_id=getattr(timeline,'turn_id',None)
            parts=[];frames=[];sample_rate=16000;channels=1;chunks=[]
            async def observed_text():
                async for chunk in text:
                    chunks.append(chunk)
                    yield chunk
            try:
                async for packet in original_tts(observed_text(),model_settings):
                    frame=getattr(packet,'frame',packet)
                    sample_rate=frame.sample_rate;channels=frame.num_channels
                    frames.append({'produced_at':time.monotonic(),'bytes':len(frame.data)})
                    parts.append(bytes(frame.data))
                    yield packet
            finally:
                if parts:
                    path=Path(os.environ['VOICE_CAPTURE_TTS_DIR']) / f'{turn_id or "greeting"}-{uuid.uuid4().hex}.wav'
                    write_wav(path,b''.join(parts),sample_rate=sample_rate,channels=channels)
                    path.with_suffix('.json').write_text(json.dumps({'room_name':room,'turn_id':turn_id,'text':''.join(chunks),'sample_rate':sample_rate,'channels':channels,'frames':frames},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
        agent.tts_node=observed_tts
        return agent
    pipeline_module.build_full_duplex_agent=observed_build
